**What You Will Do:**

We are seeking a Front-end Developer focused on Sitecore AI development to build polished, accessible, and high-performing digital experiences on our enterprise Sitecore platform. In this role, you will develop reusable front-end components and Sitecore AI solutions; translate product, content, and design requirements into maintainable implementations; create intuitive visual authoring experiences; and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve content discovery, personalization, and customer engagement. You will collaborate with the Sitecore Architect, UX designers, content teams, marketing stakeholders, back-end and integration engineers, and external partners using Sitecore XM Cloud, React, Next.js, TypeScript, the Sitecore Content SDK, GraphQL, Experience Edge, Vercel, and modern cloud delivery practices.

  

* Develop reusable, responsive, and accessible React and Next.js components for Sitecore AI, translating approved designs into clean, maintainable TypeScript.
* Create flexible component data models, rendering definitions, placeholders, variants, and visual authoring configurations that enable content teams to build pages efficiently and safely.
* Integrate frontend applications with Sitecore Experience Edge, GraphQL, the Sitecore Content SDK, and approved APIs and services.
* Develop and integrate Sitecore AI capabilities—including AI-assisted search, recommendations, content discovery, and personalization—in partnership with architecture, analytics, content, and integration teams, with appropriate privacy, security, and governance controls.
* Collaborate with UX and design teams to ensure accurate implementation of design systems, interaction patterns, responsive behavior, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Optimize Core Web Vitals, rendering performance, caching, image delivery, SEO/GEO, accessibility, and client-side application behavior.
* Write unit, integration, accessibility, and end-to-end tests; participate in code reviews; and support automated quality checks within CI/CD pipelines.
* Troubleshoot complex frontend, rendering, personalization, API, deployment, and content-delivery issues using browser tools, logs, monitoring, and root-cause analysis.
* Implement privacy-conscious analytics and engagement tracking, including approved GA4 event contracts, consent-aware behavior, and data-layer standards.
* Improve frontend standards, shared libraries, documentation, development tooling, and delivery practices while mentoring peers through reviews and knowledge sharing.

**What You Will Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of front-end or full-stack development experience, including hands-on delivery of Sitecore-based digital experiences and AI-enabled capabilities in enterprise environments.
* Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript or JavaScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS, responsive design, and component-based development.
* Hands-on experience developing headless Sitecore XM Cloud and Sitecore AI solutions using Sitecore JSS or the Sitecore Content SDK, Experience Edge, GraphQL, and Vercel.
* Experience creating Sitecore components, content models, rendering parameters, placeholders, variants, and author-friendly visual editing experiences.
* Experience consuming REST and GraphQL APIs and integrating frontend applications with enterprise services such as analytics, identity, consent management, search, CRM, or personalization platforms.
* Working knowledge of Sitecore headless patterns, composable DXP architecture, design systems, and reusable frontend architecture.
* Experience with Git-based development, pull requests, automated testing, code-quality tools, and CI/CD deployment practices.
* Demonstrated ability to improve web performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, SEO, browser compatibility, security, and frontend resilience.
* Ability to diagnose rendering, state-management, caching, API, build, deployment, and content-delivery issues across environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, collaborate across disciplines, and support peers through code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

**What Would Be Nice to Have:**

* Experience with Sitecore products such as Search, CDP, Personalize, Content Hub, or SXA.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted search, recommendations, conversational interfaces, content discovery, or personalization within customer-facing digital experiences.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure or another major cloud platform and with serverless or edge-based application patterns.
* Familiarity with Storybook, automated accessibility testing, visual regression testing, performance testing, and modern frontend observability tools.
* Knowledge of SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO) principles for structured, discoverable web content.
* Sitecore certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

* Implement secure, low-latency streaming pipelines (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) for token-by-token AI responses, agent 'thinking' states, and tool-execution progress indicators.
* Integrate authentication/authorization (OAuth2 client credentials, API Gateway via Apigee X) into frontend session and API-call flows, ensuring B2B and B2E security compliance.
* Collaborate with backend/platform engineers on API contracts, chunking/retrieval metadata exposure (for citation rendering), guardrail/response-safety signal surfacing, and error/fallback UX for model or agent failures.
* Evaluate and select appropriate technologies and tools to support the development and deployment of products on the eCommerce foundation layer
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements, and translate them into technical and non-functional specifications

* AI-Native Chat & Agent UI: Production conversational interface with streaming responses, multi-agent trace visualization, citation/grounding display, and tool-call transparency, built with React 18+/Next.js (App Router, Server Components/Actions).

* State Management: Robust conversation/session state handling using modern state libraries supporting multi-turn context and agent memory visualization.
* Accessibility & Performance: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, Core Web Vitals-optimized AI UI, with performance budgets for time-to-first token and time-to-interactive.
* Testing Suite: Component (Jest/RTL), E2E (Playwright) test suites including deterministic mocking strategies for non-deterministic LLM outputs.

* BFF / API Layer: Backend-for-Frontend service (FastAPI / Node.js) mediating between UI and AI backends, handling auth, request shaping, response streaming, and caching.

* Deployment on Kubernetes (GKE): Containerized frontend and BFF services with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Cloud Build), deployed via GKE with progressive delivery (canary/blue-green) and environment promotion aligned to platform standards.
